d:
The Mavericks defeated the Heat, 113-109 tonight in Miami. Cooper Flagg finished with a team-high 29 points along with 11 assists and 6 rebounds for the Mavericks, while P.J. Washington tallied 20 points, 9 rebounds and 4 three pointers in the game. Giannis Antetokounmpo recorded 29 points, 14 rebounds and 11 assists. The Mavericks improve their record to 2-2 with the win, while the Heat fall to 0-4 for the season.
